Starlink saves lives

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Elon Musk megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: X Freeze (@XFreeze); megjelent: 2026-11-18T19:06:50+00:00; link: https://x.com/XFreeze/status/2123130830562423103; média: videó, 10 másodperc]
Starlink is being deployed to help families cut off by flooding in rural Cuiabá, Brazil

Mato Grosso’s government is sending Starlink antennas to the Aguaçu district, where severe flooding left families isolated and without power

Emergency teams are already on the ground, while a temporary shelter is being prepared in nearby Guia

For families staying in areas where terrestrial networks are down, Starlink gives them a way to stay connected while rescue and recovery work continues

When floods knock out the infrastructure on the ground, connectivity from space becomes incredibly valuable
